capabilities: show a webpage preview when hovering external links
configure hover delay before the preview appears
set maximum preview window width and height
match the preview window to the Obsidian theme
disambiguation: Previews external web URLs on hover, not internal note links like Obsidian's Page preview.
problem: External links in notes require opening a browser tab or leaving Obsidian to see what they contain.
summary: Plugin that shows a popup preview of external webpage links when you hover over them in notes.
